episodic_memories.title: Evening planning became a reusable memory
episodic_memories.summary: The user and assistant discussed a fictional evening planning session involving dinner timing, ingredient constraints, and a warm conversational tone. The exchange may be useful as a demo of how an ordinary episode can later become retrievable context without storing the full transcript.

source.note: Fictional seed data for public examples

project_memories.title: Local AI memory experiment
project_memories.summary: A local AI stack is experimenting with an external memory service that retrieves compact memories before a chat model responds. The project keeps inferred memories tentative and separates explicit user instructions from episodic and project memories.
current_state: The memory service exposes FastAPI endpoints.
SQLite FTS5 is used for keyword-oriented retrieval.
A chat frontend can call /context/build before sending a model request.
open_questions: How should frontends expose memory review and deletion?
When should semantic embeddings be added as an optional layer?
How should nightly consolidation jobs be scheduled?

persistent_memories.title: Prefer keyword-first retrieval for technical support
persistent_memories.content: For technical support conversations, prefer keyword-searchable memories and compact evidence over opaque summaries.

source.note: Fictional explicit memory for public examples
